content.value_statement: Generic content can miss your voice, audience, and business priorities. This guided interview records those preferences for the founder-brand workflow.
actual_capabilities: Collect writing style, recurring phrases, refused phrases, and voice settings for SOUL.md.
Record anonymized case stories with metrics and user-defined writing boundaries.
Define audience knowledge and topic pools for Pillar, Proof, Process, and Person content.
Capture posting frequency, pillar rotation, platform preferences, and business destination URLs.
Guide creation of brand-config.json and SOUL.md, followed by a Proof post test.
Provide refresh guidance when voice or audience changes, with quarterly review suggested.
limitations: Requires user-supplied writing examples, audience details, and factual stories.
Provides instructions rather than an executable setup program or a formal configuration schema.
Does not provide social publishing, scheduling, URL verification, or performance tracking integrations.
Activation depends on the host and companion pack; frontmatter disables direct invocation while the body describes it.

use_cases.title: Set Up a Founder Voice
use_cases.description: Record personal writing preferences, audience needs, and business links before drafting founder-brand content.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Client Voice Profile
use_cases.description: Interview a client about preferred language, prohibited topics, and approved case stories for a consistent writing brief.

use_cases.title: Align Content Topics and Cadence
use_cases.description: Organize founder-approved topics across four pillars and record platform, rotation, and destination preferences.

prompt_templates.title: Start the Interview
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up founder-brand onboarding. Start with my writing style and ask one section at a time.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Writing Preferences
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure my voice from these approved examples: [examples]. Ask about recurring phrases, refused phrases, voice settings, and topics I will not discuss.

prompt_templates.title: Configure the Content Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: My audience is [audience]. Help define four topic pools, posting cadence, platform preferences, and business links. Ask for missing details.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh and Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Refresh onboarding for [audience change]. Preserve unchanged preferences. Review proposed file updates, then draft a Proof test post using [approved story].
prompt_templates.scenario: Update an existing profile and test consistency

output_examples.input: I write short, direct sentences. I often use 'Specifically'. I refuse 'game-changing' and avoid personal life details.
output: Writing boundary: Do not include personal life details.
Next question: Which anonymized case stories can support your Proof posts?

output_examples.input: My audience is SaaS founders. I want four LinkedIn posts weekly, rotating Pillar, Proof, Process, and Person.
output: Cadence: Four posts per week on LinkedIn.
Next question: What does this audience already know, and what does it need to learn?
Still needed: Topic pools, approved case stories, and business destination URLs.

output_examples.input: Approved story: An unnamed agency improved reply rates from 2% to 11% after rewriting outreach. Use short sentences and 'Specifically'.
output_examples.output: An agency improved reply rates from 2% to 11% after rewriting outreach. Specifically, the change was the outreach copy. That is the result this case supports.

best_practices: Use representative writing samples and choose phrases you actually use.
Provide approved, anonymized stories with accurate metrics and no confidential details.
Review saved preferences and the sample post, then refresh when your audience or voice changes.
anti_patterns: Use vague voice descriptions without concrete writing examples.
Invent case metrics or include confidential client information.
Treat configured posting cadence as an automated publishing service.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides writing SOUL.md for voice and stories, plus brand-config.json for audience, topics, cadence, and business links.

faq.question: How does onboarding start?
faq.answer: The body describes automatic loading when configuration is missing. Direct activation depends on the host because frontmatter and invocation guidance conflict.

faq.question: What should I prepare?
faq.answer: Prepare writing samples, recurring and refused phrases, anonymized case stories, audience details, topic ideas, and business destination URLs.

faq.question: Does it publish posts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It records publishing preferences and describes a sample-post test, but provides no publishing or scheduling integration.

faq.question: Can it verify my case stories?
faq.answer: No. You supply the facts and metrics. The sample-post instructions require using an actual story rather than inventing one.

faq.question: When should I refresh the configuration?
faq.answer: Refresh when your wording or audience changes. The workflow recommends reviewing preferences at least quarterly.
